name: AIVideoFree
tagline: Free AI Video Generator with No Restrictions
description:
AIVideoFree is a free AI video generator with no restrictions on model access: signup credits work with Veo, Kling, Seedance and every available model. Turn text or photos into watermark-free videos for ads, client work and products. No card is needed to start; free credits vary by country, and free or purchased credits never expire. Buy more credits as needed, with subscriptions optional. Content rules and model safety filters apply.

Freemium with finite signup credits, not unlimited or recurring free credits.
